name: exact-native-human-cell-scaling-v2
purpose: Measure exact quiescent-frontier and dense SIMD CPU simulation at 100k to one million configured active human cells.
notes: Every configured reservoir cell is active and reachable; no dormant-cell padding is used.
One token is exactly 100 fitted 0.05-ms GLIF5 integration steps.
The exact frontier scans all cell state once per token and skips only cells whose complete checkpointable state and incoming current are exactly zero.
Dense serial and deterministic five-thread SIMD timings update every cell on every integration step.
The optimized and frozen-v1 kernels consume separately constructed but seed-identical topology arrays for the 64-token bit-exact check.
uniform_no_self preserves the registered v1 seeded topology while avoiding its per-source population-sized temporary.
Training statistics are lazy; local readout arrays remain included in persistent-array memory.
